Next, we isolate the variable [MATH: w] by subtracting [MATH: w] from both sides and then adding [MATH: 8] to both sides: [MATH: w + 7|= 4w − 8; w + 7 − w|= 4w − 8 − w; 7|= 3w − 8; 15|= 3w; (15)/(3)|= w; 5|= w]

So, the value of [MATH: w] that satisfies the equation is [MATH: 5.]

[MATH: (x + 2)(x + 3)|= (x − 2)(x − 3) + 10; x^{2} + 5x + 6|= x^{2} − 5x + 6 + 10; x^{2} + 5x + 6 − x^{2} − 6|= x^{2} − 5x + 6 + 10 − x^{2} − 6; 5x|= − 5x + 10; 5x + 5x|= − 5x + 10 + 5x; 10x|= 10; (10x)/(10)|= (10)/(10); x|= 1.]
